title: Design System: Empresa de Servicios Generales

display.purpose: Large service identity and chapter headlines.

body.purpose: Navigation, service descriptions, controls and long-form copy.

shadows.name: header-glass
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation under the sticky navigation.

motion.name: confident-arrival
motion.purpose: Short entrance of the opening message.

motion.name: scroll-image-drift
motion.purpose: Subtle image movement tied to its service chapter entering and leaving the viewport.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable nonessential movement and preserve readable content.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Main action on the light or image-led surfaces.

components.name: Selected Service Filter
components.description: Current catalog filter; selection is clear in both themes.

components.name: Service Chapter
components.description: Photo-led service section with a label and readable copy.
components.html: Imagen ilustrativa

narrative.overview: The site presents general services as a guided walk through a working space. Trade photography, large condensed headlines and clear action points help visitors understand the work without treating the page like an ecommerce dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral light surfaces and evergreen dark surfaces
Locally served condensed display and sans-serif body fonts
Scroll-linked image motion with reduced-motion support

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve lime for a decisive action, a title emphasis or a small wayfinding cue.

rules.name: The Honest Work Rule
rules.body: Label stock photography as illustrative and do not present it as company work.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for large headlines and DM Sans for body, navigation and controls.

dos: Do keep service scenes full-width or editorially split rather than placing them in generic cards.
Do preserve existing auth, cart, filter, API and theme DOM contracts when editing the page.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep text visible without animation.
donts: Don't claim unverified services, credentials, testimonials, prices, response times or warranties.
Don't turn the service story into an ecommerce dashboard or uniform feature-card grid.
Don't use persistent auto-scrolling copy or gradients in text.
